reviewers.summary: The supported-claim recorder test covers its stated assertions. The endpoint-flow and client-registration tests do not prove all behavior required by their acceptance criteria.

findingList.message: TRACE-PRODUCER-11 requires proving that client resolution resolves no credential, but this test does not observe or assert credential resolution.

evidence.codePathTraced: The test resolves IChatClient and then checks only whether the configured endpoint has a pending connection.
evidence.failureScenario: If resolving IChatClient resolves a credential without making a request to the configured endpoint, listener.Pending() remains false and the test passes, despite violating TRACE-PRODUCER-11.

findingList.message: TRACE-PRODUCER-09 specifies using the committed return-status.txt fixture, but the test substitutes hard-coded text.

evidence.codePathTraced: The test passes hard-coded statusText to FixtureSourceFactory and creates the uploaded PDF from that same string; it does not load the committed return-status.txt fixture.
evidence.failureScenario: If return-status.txt changes or is missing, this test still passes using the hard-coded text, so it does not verify the fixture-backed evidence flow required by TRACE-PRODUCER-09.

reviewers.summary: The new tests cover the scripted event flow and supported-claim trace, but two required checks are missing: use of the committed synthetic fixture and detection of credential resolution during client registration.

findingList.message: TRACE-PRODUCER-09 requires the endpoint flow test to use the committed return-status.txt fixture, but the test substitutes a hardcoded string and generated PDF.

evidence.codePathTraced: AcceptedEvidenceRunsScriptedToolCallsAndPersistsOrderedEvents supplies statusText directly to the fake source and constructs the uploaded PDF from that same string; it does not load the committed return-status.txt fixture.
evidence.failureScenario: If the committed fixture changes or stops matching the uploaded evidence, this test still passes because it uses its own hardcoded text. It therefore does not verify TRACE-PRODUCER-09 with the required fixture.

findingList.message: TRACE-PRODUCER-11 does not assert that resolving IChatClient resolves no credential.

evidence.codePathTraced: HostRegistersAzureOpenAIChatClientWithoutCallingIt resolves IChatClient and checks listener.Pending(), which only detects a connection to the local endpoint; it does not observe credential resolution.
evidence.failureScenario: If resolving IChatClient resolves a credential without connecting to the endpoint, listener.Pending() remains false and the test passes, although TRACE-PRODUCER-11 requires the test to fail when a credential is resolved.

reviewers.summary: The added tests exercise the scripted trace flow and supported claim recording. The client registration test cannot detect credential resolution, leaving one required acceptance criterion unverified.

findingList.message: The host registration test does not verify that resolving IChatClient resolves no credential, as required by AC: TRACE-PRODUCER-11.

evidence.codePathTraced: The test resolves IChatClient, then checks only that the local TCP listener has no pending connection. It does not observe credential resolution.
evidence.failureScenario: If resolving IChatClient also resolves an Azure credential without making a network request, the test still passes, so AC: TRACE-PRODUCER-11 is not covered.
